name: Duolingo, Inc.
moat_justification: Moderate/narrow: dominant brand and mindshare, habit/streak mechanics and a decade of A/B-testing process power, and learner-data scale feeding AI content — but weak proven pricing power (the 2025 monetization push slowed DAU and was reversed), no hard switching costs, Apple/Google platform dependence, and free general-purpose AI lowering the entry barrier.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 7.0%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 4.81 vs 3-yr median 3.46 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 6.6x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
one_liner: High-quality learning platform, moat 5/10 — but growth has decelerated to guided ~16% revenue / ~11% bookings with SBC eating a third of operating cash flow, so at $140.10 (26.6x TTM OE of $5.26/share) the weighted IRR is only 9.4% (IV@15% $72.54); it clears the 15% hurdle only at ~$73, nearer ~$54 with a margin of safety.
moat_for: Brand and mindshare — the default language-learning app globally, organic word-of-mouth acquisition
Habit mechanics — streaks, leagues, and a decade of A/B-tested behavioral design create psychological switching costs
Learner-data scale — billions of exercises from 58.7M DAUs feed personalization and AI content generation
Recurring subscription revenue with lower-churn family plans; ~70%+ gross margins held through the AI transition
moat_against: Weak pricing power — the 2025 monetization push slowed DAU growth and management had to reverse it
AI lowers the entry barrier — free ChatGPT/Gemini/Translate offer conversational tutoring; Duolingo owns no foundation model
No hard switching costs — month-to-month subscriptions, users multi-home, no enterprise lock-in
Platform dependence on Apple/Google app stores for distribution and billing
Monetization stalling at scale — Q2 2026 bookings +8% vs DAU +23%; paid penetration ~9% of MAU after 14 years
